fields.quoted_span: Within 30 days after the termination of a tenancy, a landlord must return the security deposit, plus interest earned less deductions, to the tenant
fields.note: Every element of the requirement is in the guide: the 1.5x cap, pet deposit and prepaid rent counting toward the cap, the 2.5x inception limit, the 10% yearly increase limit, trust and interest-bearing account rules, the 10+ unit money market option, tenant ownership of interest, 30-day notice, the 7% option, return within 30 days with itemized deductions by registered or certified mail, 5 business days if displaced, and double damages with costs and fees.

fields.quoted_span:
the landlord may not require more 
than two and one-half times the monthly rent at the inception of the lease, this includes the security 
deposit and the first month’s rent.
fields.note: The document supports each element of the summary: 1.5x cap, 2.5x total at inception, 10% yearly increase cap, 30-day return, 5 business days if displaced, and double damages for wrongful withholding.
The field is empty and the guide gives no effective date for the Security Deposit Law.

fields.quoted_span:
The Security Deposit Law applies to most  residential rental properties, including mobile 
homes.
fields.note: The guide presents the law as currently applicable (in force). It gives no repeal or sunset.

fields.quoted_span:
The exception is an owner-occupied two-, or three-family dwelling. A tenant in an owner-
occupied two-, or three-family dwelling may, however, make this provision applicable to their 
tenancy 30 days  after sending a  written  request
fields.note: The guide supports the owner-occupied 2-3 family exemption with the written-request opt-in at 30 days, the inclusion of mobile homes, and the seasonal exemption (125 consecutive days or less) from the interest-bearing account provisions.

fields.quoted_span:
cannot be more than 
one and one-half times one month’s rent ( N.J.S.A. 46:8-21.2 ).
fields.note: The primary citation 46:8-21.2 is tied to the cap. The aliases (46:8-19, 19.1, 21, 21.1, 21.4, 21.5, 25, 26) all appear in the guide in the security deposit context.
